# Manual Hindi semantic review batch 331

Completed the final semantic and encoding pass for the remaining Hindi senses at the end of the English source sequence. Repaired ten entries whose Hindi text had literal `?` corruption, including `thickly`, `tropic`, `trunk`, `tug`, `tutor`, `weakly`, `whiskey`, `whisky`, `windshield`, and `witty`. The repaired examples retain the taught English headwords and match their source meanings.
